title: Clock Solitaire

tutorial.clockFace: Cards are arranged in clock positions.
tutorial.centerPile: The center pile is for Kings.
tutorial.controls: Step advances one card, Auto Play runs to completion.
tutorial.resetButton: Press Reset to start a new game.

hint.firstStep: Step from the center pile to start.
hint.continueStep: Keep stepping the current card onto its clock-position pile.

landscapeBanner: Rotate to landscape for a better experience
